import http.server, socketserver, threading, time

class H(http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
    def log_message(self, *a): pass

srv = socketserver.TCPServer(("127.0.0.1", 8098), H)
t = threading.Thread(target=srv.serve_forever, daemon=True)
t.start()
time.sleep(0.5)

import socket
for u in ["/", "/blog.html", "/publications.html", "/assets/css/style.css", "/assets/js/main.js"]:
    s = socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", 8098), timeout=5)
    s.sendall(b"GET " + u.encode() + b" HTTP/1.0\r\nHost: 127.0.0.1:8098\r\n\r\n")
    status = s.recv(200).split(b" ")[1].decode()
    s.close()
    print(status, "http://127.0.0.1:8098" + u)

srv.shutdown()
srv.server_close()
time.sleep(0.3)
s = socket.socket()
try:
    s.connect(("127.0.0.1", 8098))
    print("PORT STILL OPEN")
except OSError:
    print("port 8098 closed — no server left")
finally:
    s.close()
EOF
